# Dark-Web Apps & Tools Directory

**6,780 unique dark-web / investigation tool URLs** across **10 categories** and **16 types**.

Last reviewed 2026-11-23T09:00:17Z.

**Scope:** dark-web monitoring, leak-site and ransomware tracking, onion search and discovery, dark-web OSINT, cybercrime threat intelligence, privacy and anonymity environments, breach/identity exposure intelligence, ransomware cryptocurrency tracing, investigation/link analysis, and curated dark-web/OSINT resource lists.

**Excluded:** generic Kali-style pentest tools, port and vulnerability scanners, exploit/malware development, bug-bounty and CTF tooling, general-purpose SIEM/SOAR, and spam/off-topic repositories.

This repository contains URLs, Markdown indexes, and JSON data only. It contains no software code, exploit code, or downloadable payloads.

## Verification levels

| Level | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `primary-verified` | Also present in `rsearch/registry/tools.json` with primary evidence. |
| `indexed` | Discovered from a named public index; provenance recorded, not individually primary-verified. |
| `legacy` | Already in the original repository, cross-referenced once. |
| `archived` | Upstream source reports the project as archived. |
